description: Expose every canonical Maker Valuation field in the saved case display and produce a readable all-field PDF.
steps: Read context.json and this feature file first. In e:/codefiles/va2/src/routes/_app/cases.$caseId.index.tsx replace the partial saved Maker Valuation card with complete grouped sections matching the canonical inventory: Basic, Additional, General, Boundary/Location/Occupancy, Apartment, Flat, Marketability, Area, Rate, Details, Calculation, and Remarks.

Use a shared display helper or local row component that renders an em dash for empty values instead of omitting a field. Include every text/select/numeric/date field, all area basis fields, carParkingValue, both government rates, rentRangePerMonth, insuranceValue, all calculated values, and long text values.

In e:/codefiles/va2/src/server/makerValuationPdf.server.ts retain all 115 rows, add section headings, wrap long labels and values, and paginate without clipping/overlap. Keep formatDisplayDate for the two dates and show em dashes for nulls. Remove stale minimal/five-field comments.
Run the feature verification commands and update this FEAT file status to completed, recording the display/PDF evidence needed by later steps. Commit locally on the current branch; never push.
acceptance_criteria: The saved card visibly accounts for all 115 canonical labels and displays the saved value or an em dash for each.
The PDF contains all 115 canonical labels and values across readable pages, with section headings and wrapped long content.
No display or PDF field is renamed, duplicated, or replaced by a fake field; calculated values remain the persisted calculated values.
Rate Range remains displayed as the open numeric field's saved value; no dropdown is introduced.
verification: From e:/codefiles/va2 run npx tsc --noEmit and expect exit code 0.
From e:/codefiles/va2 run npm run build and expect exit code 0.
Use the saved Dev Auto-Fill record, inspect the Maker Valuation tab for all section rows, download the PDF, and verify extracted PDF text contains every canonical label/value across the pages.
findings: Audit findings: the current route card renders Basic plus only three Area rows, four Rate rows, five calculated/detail rows, and non-empty Remarks. The current PDF source has rows for all fields but no section headings or robust wrapping and still documents itself as minimal.
implementation_findings: Added one shared canonical label/key inventory with 115 unique fields. The saved Maker Valuation card now renders all sections and every field through a reusable row helper, preserving long text and showing an em dash for null/empty values. The edit form already receives the complete makerValuation object from FEAT-001. Rebuilt the PDF renderer around the same inventory with section headings, wrapped labels/values, and safe page breaks; both date fields still use formatDisplayDate. Rate Range remains a saved open numeric value and calculated values are rendered from persisted fields.
verification_findings: npx tsc --noEmit passed. npm run build passed. A synthetic all-field PDF smoke test counted 115 canonical fields, 115 unique keys, and generated a 4-page PDF without errors. Targeted ESLint passed for the changed route, PDF, and shared inventory files. npm run lint was run but remains blocked by 5,440 repository-wide pre-existing formatting errors (including FEAT-001 files and generated/unrelated source); no unrelated bulk formatting was applied. The live saved-record/browser PDF extraction smoke test requires the authenticated app session and was not executable from this subagent.
